comment: Every SQL statement of apps/api/src/modules/tenancy/repository.ts at 4319177 — the API version before the P5.5 enforcement migration — that reads or writes tenancy.merchants, branches, roles or invitations directly, constants folded. The mixed-version test runs each as alphakolect_app against the migrated database: every one must fail with insufficient_privilege (P5 plan §7.2 "Enforcement boundary", ADR-16 B1).

statements.sql: SELECT id, name, status FROM tenancy.merchants WHERE id = $1
UPDATE tenancy.merchants SET name = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, name, status
SELECT id, name, status, created_at, archived_at FROM tenancy.branches WHERE merchant_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT id, name, status, created_at, archived_at FROM tenancy.roles WHERE merchant_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT id, name, status, created_at, archived_at FROM tenancy.branches WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND id = $2
SELECT id, name, status, created_at, archived_at FROM tenancy.roles WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND id = $2
INSERT INTO tenancy.branches (merchant_id, name) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id, name, status, created_at, archived_at
INSERT INTO tenancy.roles (merchant_id, name) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id, name, status, created_at, archived_at

UPDATE tenancy.branches SET name = coalesce($3, name), status = coalesce($4, status), archived_at = CASE WHEN coalesce($4, status) = 'active' THEN NULL WHEN status = 'archived' THEN archived_at ELSE now() END, updated_at = now() WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND id = $2 RETURNING id, name, status, created_at, archived_at

UPDATE tenancy.roles SET name = coalesce($3, name), status = coalesce($4, status), archived_at = CASE WHEN coalesce($4, status) = 'active' THEN NULL WHEN status = 'archived' THEN archived_at ELSE now() END, updated_at = now() WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND id = $2 RETURNING id, name, status, created_at, archived_at

SELECT id, email, kind, role_id, branch_id, expires_at, accepted_at, revoked_at, created_at FROM tenancy.invitations WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id = $2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
